_comment: v4rian pool/* deletion lock. Developers NEVER delete branches - theirs or anyone else's - and CI never deletes either: the vault receipt is the archive, the merged pool ref lingers until an admin sweep (bin/post-merge-lifecycle). Covers reconcile candidates too (the auto-rebase rolls them forward by force-pushing the canonical name in place, never by deleting). Bypass actors: repository admins only. Apply via .io.v4rian.neo-git/scripts/apply-repo-rules.sh.
name: v4rian-pool-deletions
